name: oneshot-agent
description: Your AI coding agent writes last year's versions from memory. OneShot gives it today's: current packages, AI model names, GitHub Actions, Node/Python and Docker versions, so it gets it right in one shot.

scripts.demo: node bin/oneshot.js run tasks --agent claude --model sonnet --trials 2 --out results/demo && node bin/oneshot.js report results --out site
